capabilities: Create a new note and link it bidirectionally with the current note
Copy a note's [[wiki link]] to the clipboard
Insert [[]] and trigger the native link autocomplete
Add create-link and copy-link options to the file explorer context menu
extras: The manifest carries Obsidian's notice that the plugin has not been manually reviewed by staff; README is available in English and Korean.
problem: Creating a linked note and wiring up backlinks normally takes several manual steps of making the file, inserting the link, and editing the new note.
summary: Link helper that creates new notes with bidirectional links, copies a note's wiki link, and triggers link autocomplete via commands and context menus.
